quote: Wieferich primes were first described by Arthur Wieferich in 1909 in works pertaining to Fermat's Last Theorem
note: The generalized problem asks about infinitely many primes p such that a^p ≡ 1 (mod p²) for any integer a > 0. Wieferich's 1909 work 'Zum letzten Fermat'schen Theorem' (Journal für die reine und angewandte Mathematik, vol. 136, pp. 293–302) introduced Wieferich primes in the context of Fermat's Last Theorem, specifically for base 2. The broader generalization to arbitrary bases a follows from this foundational work.
